paragraphs: R' Shimon, a student of R' Yochanan, son of Yaakov of Tyre, Berakhot 33a.
Rabbi Yishmael, son of Yaakov of Tyre, Ketubot 7a.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The exact Davidson Ketubot 7a passage spells out רבי ישמעאל בן יעקב דמן צור, supporting son of Yaakov for ב״י and Rabbi Yishmael in this occurrence. It does not supply a title to Yaakov or the distinct Berakhot report.

לג./ז. give 33a/7a by convention. The Shimon/Yochanan student qualification is preserved as Hyman’s report, with their titles R'; the father is Yaakov, not Yochanan. Tyre is the contextual locative rendering, not a canonical geographic/authority binding or proof of one father for both sons.
